workflow_observation.workflow_name: Prepare a channel-ready campaign asset batch
workflow_observation.trigger: A campaign asset batch has approved product selection and is ready for channel preparation.
ordered_steps: Maya confirms the approved product IDs and offer wording.
Jun collects final photography, channel dimensions, and branch variants from the separate source handoffs.
Jun consolidates the approved inputs into one batch folder.
Maya checks completeness before scheduling and returns incomplete batches for correction.
exceptions_and_rework: Missing photography, copy, dimensions, or branch variants returns the batch for correction.
measurement_gaps: Measure active preparation and correction minutes per batch.
Measure wait time between the separate input handoffs.

Darren accepts it as publish-ready or returns named exceptions before publishing. The method was reused for two listing batches; timing and weekly volume require measurement. [TASK-203]

workflow_observation.workflow_name: Prepare a publish-ready product listing handoff
workflow_observation.trigger: An approved product batch is ready for Ecommerce listing.
ordered_steps: Nur confirms the approved product IDs and samples in the batch.
Nur validates title, category, dimensions, composition, care, price, and stock fields against the approved product record.
Nur checks approved images, crops, and alt text against each product ID in the shared asset folder.
Nur assembles the listing package using the listing handoff checklist.
Darren accepts the package as publish-ready or returns named exceptions to Nur before publishing.
handoffs: Nur prepares and checks the listing package, then hands it to Darren for acceptance and publishing.
exceptions_and_rework: Reopen the handoff if catalog sync removes a required value.
measurement_gaps: Measure active preparation time and wait time per batch.
